- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#4 ("Outline rev 4: cells the figures need that the analysis plan lacks") by `experiment-repo`  > Settled in `ANALYSIS_PLAN.md` rev. 1 (commit follows this comment); all added runs are labelled "added in rev. 1" and are Tier G (+ `or_known`) unless said.
  > 1. **Fine s grid (A1)**: runs `fine_SBM_n3000_d{5,20,80}_p0.5`, s ∈ {0.1,…,0.9} × (a)–(f) + null, G=10×R=300. Caveat that goes with Fig 1: (e) at s=0.9 is truncated at K=30 steps (τ=0.96 before normalising; errors are normalised by the exact τ) and the `or_fit` grid stops at ρ=0.85.
  > 2. **Cluster designs (A2)**: `clus_{SBMweak (mix 0.6), ego-Facebook, Stanford3}_d20_res{0.3,1,3}` + SBMweak truth, next to the existing SBM/ER/BA. Per-run cluster count, size min/median/max, modularity, conductance and P(all clusters same arm) are written to `cluster_quality.csv`; NaN/undefined rate per estimator is the `defined` column of `cells`.
  > 3. **DC-SBM (A3)**: implemented (lognormal θ, σ_θ=0.8, blocks of 100, mean degree solved after clipping): `dc_DCSBM_n3000_d{5,20,80}_p{0.25,0.5}` and degree-correlated-baseline `dcbase_DCSBM_deg_…`. The plain SBM stays the "equal-degree" family.
  > 4. **Convex mirror (A4)**: mechanism (g) = (1−s)z + s·(1−g_sat(1−f)), `convex_SBM_n3000_d{5,20,80}_p0.5` and d=20 at p ∈ {0.25,0.75}, with `or_known`; no `or_fit` for (g). Exploratory.
  > 5. **Fig 9 points (A5)**: HC0 coverage for `chin` is on **all** 3000 draws per synthetic cell (MC SE ≈0.4 pp near 95 %, stored as `coverage_hc_mc_se`); the bootstrap (B=100, ≈7 % SE error) stays on the first 300 draws and is labelled as such (`coverage_method`). Fig 9 should use the HC0 column; the bootstrap column is the DM CI.
  > 6. Venue budget: not mine.
  > Also added, from the review in #5: variance components per cell (`var_{noise,base,misfit,cross}_share`) and `lowbase_*` runs (unit-baseline SD 0.25) so that the misfit share is not negligible.
